items.stem: Which Google Cloud resource sits above projects and lets you apply IAM policies and organization policies to groups of projects?

options.rationale: A region is a geographic location, not a policy scope.

options.text: A folder in the resource hierarchy
options.rationale: Correct: folders group projects and allow IAM and org policies to be applied and inherited.
A VPC is a networking construct, not a policy-grouping layer above projects.
An instance is a single VM, not a grouping layer.

items.explanation: Correct: folders group projects and allow IAM and org policies to be applied and inherited.

items.stem: Which TWO practices support least-privilege access in a Google Cloud project? (Select TWO)

options.text: Granting predefined or custom roles scoped to needed permissions
options.rationale: Correct: granular predefined/custom roles support least privilege.

options.text: Using service accounts with only the permissions a workload needs
options.rationale: Correct: narrowly scoped service accounts follow least privilege.

options.text: Giving every user the Owner role
options.rationale: Owner is overly broad and violates least privilege.

options.text: Sharing a single admin login among the team
options.rationale: Shared logins break accountability and least privilege.
IAM cannot be disabled and is required for access control.

items.explanation: Both keyed options are correct; all-or-nothing scoring requires exactly the keyed set.
